data.title: XRP ETFs see inflows for 13th week; Bitcoin, Et... | Pluang
data.description: U.S.-listed XRP ETFs continued their inflow streak for the 13th consecutive week ending Oct. 9, attracting $11.31 million and raising cumulative inflows to $1.80 billion. Meanwhile, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana ETFs experienced significant outflows totaling nearly $1.25 billion, with Bitcoin funds withdrawing $681.10 million, Ethereum $542.07 million, and Solana $24.81 million. This marks a reversal for Bitcoin after three weeks of inflows, consistent withdrawals for Ethereum over five sessions, and the end of a 14-week inflow streak for Solana. Despite XRP's inflows, total net assets for XRP ETFs declined to $1.57 billion. These flows reflect shifting investor sentiment across major crypto ETFs.
data.author: Tokenpost
